recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20352 unless a future work-group decision narrows DocumentReference.subject or requests targeted explanatory text.
issue_request: FHIR-20352 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO R5 change request to add additional DocumentReference.subject targets. The original description asked for Group, PractitionerRole, Specimen, and Location; the final resolution added PractitionerRole, Specimen, Organization, and Location after noting Group was already present.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in PR #716 by commit 24ebc2aadefd4ba91d3d5380d091e15c61a202e2, which changed the then-authoritative DocumentReference spreadsheet from Reference(Patient|Practitioner|Group|Device) to include PractitionerRole, Specimen, Organization, and Location. The later StructureDefinition XML migration preserved that enumerated target set before subsequent broadening.
additional_context: FHIR-32576 was a later Published/Persuasive R5 OO decision to make DocumentReference.subject Any. Commit c585283d64d014e0629d680fa7ad132c2acdaf36 intentionally replaced the enumerated target profiles with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Resource, and the combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-32576 audit commit. Direct FHIR-20352 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active current StructureDefinition defines DocumentReference.subject as Reference(Resource), which includes PractitionerRole, Specimen, Organization, Location, Group, and all other resources; narrowing it back to the FHIR-20352 enumerated list would undo the later FHIR-32576 decision.

related_jiras.note: Later Published OO decision made DocumentReference.subject Reference(Any), superseding the older enumerated target list while still including all FHIR-20352 requested targets.
